description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerDao class within the OrangeHRM application, specifically in the performance plugin. It provides data access methods for handling performance tracker entities, including retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and related queries on performance tracker data, reviewers, and logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing PerformanceTracker entities, including CRUD operations, reviewer management, and filtering based on various parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTracker entity by its ID if it exists and is active.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of performance trackers from a list of IDs that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackList
methods.description: Returns a list of PerformanceTrackers based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of PerformanceTrackers matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: savePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Saves a PerformanceTracker entity along with its reviewers, managing transaction boundaries.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerReviewers
methods.description: Associates reviewers with a performance tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for fetching performance trackers based on search parameters.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Soft deletes performance trackers by marking their status as deleted.

methods.name: getReviewerListByTrackerId
methods.description: Retrieves list of reviewer entities associated with a specific performance tracker.

methods.name: updatePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Updates a performance tracker, including reviewer list modifications.

methods.name: deleteExistingReviewers
methods.description: Removes specified reviewers from a performance tracker.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerList
methods.description: Fetches performance trackers based on employee tracker search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerCount
methods.description: Counts the number of employee trackers matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for employee tracker list filtering.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all performance tracker IDs.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs associated with a reviewer ID.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs associated with an employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Returns employee IDs for performance trackers reviewed by a specific reviewer.

methods.name: isTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Checks if an employee is a reviewer for any tracker.

methods.name: isTrackerOwnerEditable
methods.description: Determines whether a performance tracker can be edited based on log entries.
